checks.statement: Use bottom sheets for supplementary content, not the app’s primary content, at compact and medium breakpoints.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Bottom sheets guidance.

evidence.result: The specimen presents supporting text and a sample field/actions, but contains no primary application content/context to judge whether the sheet is supplementary.

implementation.notes: The specimen presents supporting text and a sample field/actions, but contains no primary application content/context to judge whether the sheet is supplementary.

checks.statement: Place a scrim behind modal bottom sheets; standard bottom sheets have no scrim.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Bottom sheets guidance.

evidence.result: Modal control uses native dialog, which renders its backdrop; standard control uses a section and has no backdrop.

implementation.notes: Modal control uses native dialog, which renders its backdrop; standard control uses a section and has no backdrop.

checks.statement: Use standard sheets for complementary content that must remain visible and interactive alongside the main screen; at full-screen height provide an app-bar collapse control.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Standard bottom sheets guidance.

evidence.result: Standard sheet is an absolutely positioned bottom sheet in a clipped demo frame, so concurrent interaction with a real main screen and full-screen collapse control are not represented.

implementation.notes: Standard sheet is an absolutely positioned bottom sheet in a clipped demo frame, so concurrent interaction with a real main screen and full-screen collapse control are not represented.

checks.statement: Use modal sheets for blocking choices such as long action lists with descriptions or icons; modal bottom sheets are for mobile apps.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Modal bottom sheets guidance.

evidence.result: This implementation is a web component preview; the source recommendation limits modal bottom sheets to mobile apps, whose platform behavior is not represented here.

implementation.notes: This implementation is a web component preview; the source recommendation limits modal bottom sheets to mobile apps, whose platform behavior is not represented here.

checks.statement: Cap the initial modal sheet height at 50% of the screen; allow taller content to expand to full screen and scroll internally.
checks.condition: For modal sheets whose content exceeds the initial view.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Visibility guidance.

evidence.result: Modal height is fixed to peek/expanded renderer presets with an 85svh maximum; there is no initial-open 50%-of-viewport cap or automatic full-height expansion policy.

implementation.notes: Modal height is fixed to peek/expanded renderer presets with an 85svh maximum; there is no initial-open 50%-of-viewport cap or automatic full-height expansion policy.

checks.statement: Allow modal sheets to close from a selected action, scrim tap, downward swipe, or available app-bar close control; show a close affordance for full-screen modal sheets.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Visibility guidance.

evidence.result: Actions/close button call close, native dialog handles Escape, backdrop pointer gesture closes, and pointer drag can resize or dismiss; full-screen-specific close visibility is not conditionally enforced.

implementation.notes: Actions/close button call close, native dialog handles Escape, backdrop pointer gesture closes, and pointer drag can resize or dismiss; full-screen-specific close visibility is not conditionally enforced.

checks.statement: On compact screens, span the screen width; on larger screens apply a default max width, allow override when needed, and consider a side sheet on expanded desktop layouts.
checks.condition: When adapting bottom sheets across breakpoints.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Responsive layout guidance.

evidence.result: Standard sheet fills parent width; modal dialog caps at 40rem. The demo parent itself is 28rem and has no responsive side-sheet substitution, so breakpoint behavior needs host-level assessment.

implementation.notes: Standard sheet fills parent width; modal dialog caps at 40rem. The demo parent itself is 28rem and has no responsive side-sheet substitution, so breakpoint behavior needs host-level assessment.

checks.statement: Allow sheets to cycle preset heights and close without dragging; provide a single-pointer alternative if multiple heights exist without a drag handle.
checks.condition: When a sheet offers preset heights.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Custom positioning guidance.

evidence.result: The focusable handle toggles between minimized and expanded states on click/keyboard without requiring drag.

implementation.notes: The focusable handle toggles between minimized and expanded states on click/keyboard without requiring drag.

checks.statement: Provide a non-dragging single-pointer way to change sheet height; selecting the drag handle cycles through available heights, or provide a button if no usable handle exists.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Dragging guidance.

evidence.result: A button handle cycles the two preset states on activation, providing a single-pointer alternative to dragging.

implementation.notes: A button handle cycles the two preset states on activation, providing a single-pointer alternative to dragging.

checks.statement: Make a visible drag handle keyboard/switch focusable and operable.
checks.condition: When a drag handle is present.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Initial focus guidance.

evidence.result: Handle is a native button, receives dynamic expanded/label attributes, and has visible focus styling on its mark.

implementation.notes: Handle is a native button, receives dynamic expanded/label attributes, and has visible focus styling on its mark.

checks.statement: Label only the drag handle and expose it with the button role.
checks.condition: When a drag handle is present.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Labeling guidance.

evidence.result: The handle is a button with no visible text; runtime assigns the action name Expand sheet or Minimize sheet.

implementation.notes: The handle is a button with no visible text; runtime assigns the action name Expand sheet or Minimize sheet.

checks.statement: Use a 28dp top corner radius, a maximum width of 640dp, and an optional drag handle with an accessible 48dp hit target.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Differences from M2 instructions.

evidence.result: Shape is tokenized and handle target is space600; 40rem max width applies only to modal dialog, while standard bottom sheet fills its parent. The requested resolved radius and all-variant max width need token/layout verification.

implementation.notes: Shape is tokenized and handle target is space600; 40rem max width applies only to modal dialog, while standard bottom sheet fills its parent. The requested resolved radius and all-variant max width need token/layout verification.

checks.statement: Use surface-container-low for the sheet, on-surface-variant for the drag handle, and the scrim role for modal sheets; Android handles scrim color and opacity through system UI.
checks.condition: For bottom-sheet color roles; Android scrim behavior is platform-managed.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Color instructions.

evidence.result: Sheet/scrim use token-backed custom properties, but this code does not establish the exact surface-container-low and on-surface-variant role values or Android system-managed scrim.

implementation.notes: Sheet/scrim use token-backed custom properties, but this code does not establish the exact surface-container-low and on-surface-variant role values or Android system-managed scrim.

checks.statement: Use a 72dp top margin and centered drag handle with 22dp top/bottom padding; when window width exceeds 640dp, use 56dp top and side margins and cap sheet width at 640dp.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Measurements instructions.

evidence.result: Handle uses a 48px square target with 4px block margins and 4px header padding; there is no 72dp top margin, 22dp handle vertical padding, or 56dp expanded-window inset/max-width layout for the standard sheet.

implementation.notes: Handle uses a 48px square target with 4px block margins and 4px header padding; there is no 72dp top margin, 22dp handle vertical padding, or 56dp expanded-window inset/max-width layout for the standard sheet.

checks.statement: Use sheets for supplementary mobile content and actions; their flexible content may include lists, actions, supplemental text, thumbnails, images, or video.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Usage instructions.

evidence.result: The content region supports supporting text, a field and actions through a flex body/footer; arbitrary media/list types are not constrained by the container.

implementation.notes: The content region supports supporting text, a field and actions through a flex body/footer; arbitrary media/list types are not constrained by the container.

checks.statement: The container is the only required sheet element; size it to the content it contains, while treating handle and modal scrim as optional/variant-specific.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Container instructions.

evidence.result: The template includes optional handle, header/body/footer, while sheet height is fixed by renderer presets rather than content; intrinsic content-sizing behavior is not established.

implementation.notes: The template includes optional handle, header/body/footer, while sheet height is fixed by renderer presets rather than content; intrinsic content-sizing behavior is not established.

checks.statement: A standard sheet may continue below the screen with supplementary content; provide preset positions from a preview to full-screen when useful.
checks.condition: For standard bottom sheets with extensive content.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Standard bottom sheets instructions.

evidence.result: Body scrolls independently and has minimized/expanded states; support for standard sheets continuing below the viewport or a full-screen preset is not shown.

implementation.notes: Body scrolls independently and has minimized/expanded states; support for standard sheets continuing below the viewport or a full-screen preset is not shown.

checks.statement: A modal sheet blocks all other app functionality and stays until confirmed, dismissed, or a required action is taken; use it as a mobile alternative to a menu or simple dialog for long choices or choices needing descriptions/icons.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Modal bottom sheets instructions.

evidence.result: Modal sheet is a native dialog opened modally and remains open until action/close, Escape, backdrop or drag dismissal.

implementation.notes: Modal sheet is a native dialog opened modally and remains open until action/close, Escape, backdrop or drag dismissal.

checks.statement: On medium and expanded layouts, use a default maximum width to avoid awkward spacing; override only when needed, and consider a non-transient floating sheet for complex flows.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Responsive layout instructions.

evidence.result: Only the specimen parent and modal width are capped; no medium/expanded breakpoint or floating-sheet layout is present for application flows.

implementation.notes: Only the specimen parent and modal width are capped; no medium/expanded breakpoint or floating-sheet layout is present for application flows.

checks.statement: At compact breakpoints, extend the bottom sheet across the screen width and elevate it above primary content.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Compact breakpoint instructions.

evidence.result: Standard sheet spans its containing frame; modal sheet uses 100svw when narrower than the 40rem cap and anchors to the bottom.

implementation.notes: Standard sheet spans its containing frame; modal sheet uses 100svw when narrower than the 40rem cap and anchors to the bottom.

checks.statement: On expanded desktop layouts, a side sheet may present the same content more suitably than a bottom sheet.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Medium and expanded breakpoints instructions.

evidence.result: This owned component preview exercises bottom sheets; the separate side-sheet family owns the expanded desktop alternative.

implementation.notes: This owned component preview exercises bottom sheets; the separate side-sheet family owns the expanded desktop alternative.

checks.statement: Allow a sheet to present collapsed or fully raised states; the system or user may control the transition to provide a predictable footprint.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Behavior instructions.

evidence.result: Runtime exposes minimized/expanded states, updates aria-expanded and allows click/keyboard toggling; pointer drag also selects a preset.

implementation.notes: Runtime exposes minimized/expanded states, updates aria-expanded and allows click/keyboard toggling; pointer drag also selects a preset.

checks.statement: Allow sheet content to scroll independently when it exceeds the initially visible height; horizontal scrolling may also be independent of the rest of the screen.
checks.condition: When sheet content exceeds its initial view.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Scrolling instructions.

evidence.result: Sheet content is a flex column with a min-block-size:0 body using overflow:auto, independent of the page/frame.

implementation.notes: Sheet content is a flex column with a min-block-size:0 body using overflow:auto, independent of the page/frame.

checks.statement: On Android predictive back, detach the sheet from both screen edges and preview the previous screen; releasing or flinging commits the gesture and cancelling keeps the sheet open.
checks.condition: On Android when predictive back is supported.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Back instructions.

evidence.result: The implementation is browser JavaScript using HTMLDialogElement and has no Android predictive-back integration or native Android runtime.

implementation.notes: The implementation is browser JavaScript using HTMLDialogElement and has no Android predictive-back integration or native Android runtime.

checks.statement: Provide a way to resize a bottom sheet without relying on touch gestures.
checks.condition: When users can resize the sheet.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Use cases instructions.

evidence.result: Resizing is available from a focusable button via keyboard in addition to pointer gestures.

implementation.notes: Resizing is available from a focusable button via keyboard in addition to pointer gestures.

checks.statement: When user-initiated resizing is available and the handle is present, reserve the top 48dp of the sheet as the resize interaction area.
checks.condition: For a sheet with an interactive drag handle.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Touch target area instructions.

evidence.result: Handle has a space600 square target, but the requirement reserves the sheet top 48dp as a resize interaction area; this code only makes the handle itself interactive.

implementation.notes: Handle has a space600 square target, but the requirement reserves the sheet top 48dp as a resize interaction area; this code only makes the handle itself interactive.

checks.statement: Allow the optional drag handle to receive keyboard/switch focus and operate it with non-touch input.
checks.condition: When a drag handle is present.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Initial focus instructions.

evidence.result: The drag handle is a native button with a visible focus outline treatment.

implementation.notes: The drag handle is a native button with a visible focus outline treatment.

checks.statement: Tab focuses the drag handle; Space or Enter toggles between the available sheet heights.
checks.condition: When resizing is available through a drag handle.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Keyboard navigation instructions.

evidence.result: Keyboard handler maps ArrowUp/Home and ArrowDown/End, but Space/Enter use a click toggle and are not explicitly tested; native button activation is present yet exact toggling requirement is supported by default activation semantics. Use focusable native button as implementation evidence.

implementation.notes: Keyboard handler maps ArrowUp/Home and ArrowDown/End, but Space/Enter use a click toggle and are not explicitly tested; native button activation is present yet exact toggling requirement is supported by default activation semantics. Use focusable native button as implementation evidence.
